record.title: River Rush VFXs and Animations
record.description:
We need a couple of animations and VFXs for the river rush event for both the ships and the icons etc. I will list the animations chronologically. 

1. **INFINITE LIVES FLOATING ANIMATION**
   1. The infinite lives floating to the life count. Once the event is activated, we're gonna show the infinite lives as a reward just like in any screen we do. After claiming it, the infinite lives are gonna float to life area. We might have that animation but if not we can have something similar to coins animations. 

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6047]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52034])
2. **MINOR ICON ANIMATION AFTER LEVEL WIN** 
   1. After level completion and returning to the saga map, the event icon should have a small animation just to emphasize something changed in the event. Take this video for instance, they use the drill machine and merges into the icon with a cool animation in 00:07. But I think we can use something like just rotating the wheel in our icon and merging it to the icon. 

      ![image.png]([URL_52033])

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6046]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52032])
3. **SHIP IDLE ANIMATION**
   1. Ships should have small idle animation where it just floats above the river with some circular splash. Look at the second half of the video for instance. Apart from movement animation, they have a small idle animation like just rotating drill. So we can have a small waving animation for the ships as well as small splash from the ship. 

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6045]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52031])
4. **SHIP MOVEMENT ANIMATION**
   1. Ships movement will be considered as a progress bar but they will move continuously and smoothly. So the ship movement will be like a smoothed progress bar. But we also need a splash animation in the back of the ship to show that ships are moving forward. 

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6045]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52030])
5. **RACE WIN - COIN ANIMATION**
   1. Once the race is over, a player's ship will pass the cross line and become invisible. When the race is over, we can show coins from the side like a confetti. Just like how they did in mine dash but we are gonna use it horizontal - from right side towards left. 

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6044]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52029])

record.title: Julius Character & Ability Implementation
record.description:
* Integration of character model and the animations
* New Ability - Vanishing Tile only (-1) tile from hand 
* New Ability - Changing wild tile cost to 1500
* New Ability - Converting child tiles into a gold tile

---

Vfx implementation:

[Magic101.mp4]([URL_50497])

[Wild103.mp4]([URL_50496])

[DiscardTwo104.mp4]([URL_50495])

![image.png]([URL_50494])

So julius is holding two vfx elements in his staff, one its the discard magic one and the other oneits the wildcard. 

![image.png]([URL_50493])

Depending on his level we hide and unhide the right one.

The way we play his animations now depending on what magic he needs to do is this:

![image.png]([URL_50492])

We trigger Cast_Wildcard so it plays the converting wildcard animation

and we trigger CastBoard to do the discard tile one.

![image.png]([URL_50491])

His Animations that are triggered by the animator controller have Animation Events, The first one triggers a trigger parameter on to staffTip animator controller, it makes a buildup vfx animation part at the specific time during Julius animation.

![image.png]([URL_50490])

The second animation event sets MagicDiscardTile to active, Depending on how many tiles he removes from the board we hide or unhide the second child MagicDiscardTile2, the first one will always stay on to produce the 1 tile discard animation vfx.

![image.png]([URL_50489])

The wildcard effect has the same kind of workflow on the animation events.

In order for this to work we must MAKE SURE that we have the elements placed in his Cast Magic Event component on his Julius_Model!

![image.png]([URL_50488])

In order to remove the tile from the board The MagicDiscardTile1 has a dummy scale animation that does do nothing to but just starts another animation to the discarded tile, wich is a rotation and a scale.

![image.png]([URL_50487])

In the case of the wildcard the magicWildCard object effect plays an dotween animation on the DominoWildTile that sits on the board that basically scales it up to position, and while it does that it triggers another dottween animation that animates the Replaced tile wich it scales down , making the effect of replacing the tile with a wildcard .

![image.png]([URL_50486])

So in the end i belive Domino tiles need to have a discard animation added to it and a replace animation while the wildcard need to have the poping in animation that will replace the normal tile.

I belive this it's all if u have any trouble with this please let me know and i will be able to help! Good luck!

record.title: Streak Counter in the objectives should reset when the current streak is finished.
record.description:
The current streak counter always shows the best streak achieved, but as a player, it might get confusing because players might use their booster to achieve more streak according to the streak counter. 

The expected result would be :

* The streak counter increases as the last match made. 
* When the streak is interrupted, the number should be reset to 0. 
  * However, if the earlier streak count achieves 2 or 3 stars, the stars should be saved with a green mark.
  * Streak counter shows only the current streak while objectives are saved in the stars. 
* So, the VFX can be triggered with every match because in that way, it should always show the number increasing. 

[Screen Recording [CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_1063].mp4]([URL_50514])

![image.png]([URL_50513])

Like if i got 14 streaks and it was finished, The counter should show green marks as all the stars achieved, and it should show the current streak count.

record.title: In streak tutorial, lower parts are not interactable leading to tutorial break. (1:37)
Train Level Bugs
record.description:
1. Rewind is working but if player rewind until a tile in the previous section returns to the board. The game cannot be passable since there is a tile that we cannot match nor see. 2 possible scenarios to eliminate this are:
   1. disable rewind when a new train level section starts
   2. move train backwards so that we can see the open tiles in the previous sections.
2. Open tile removal ability can remove tiles from further sections. Those tiles might fall into where the train is, which leads to blocking the route of the train. But the level continues with camera movements. The train stops because it detects where to stop by the presence of tiles. 
   1. The expected outcome is **limiting the ability's area by the visibility, what can be seen in that moment.** 
3. Bomb boost and ability can randomly select tiles that are in the further sections. To eliminate that, we should **limit the ability's area by the visibility, what can be seen in that moment.**

record.title: Rewind and Streak Abilities Bugs
record.description:
* Removes random face up tiles
  * Player can try to remove every tile by simply matching and rewinding back and forth.
* Gold tile in the 3rd position
  * Player can spawn as many gold tiles as he wants by using rewind back and forth.
* +1 Draw Tile +1 Gold Tile in 3rd Position
  * Player can spawn as many gold tiles as he wants by using rewind back and forth. But the +1 tile can be rewound.
* +1 Dynamite Tile
  * Once it’s achieved, the rewind is locked.

**Those are the cases and the loopholes to exploit or potential bugs.** 

**Expected Result:**

If any of the issues is easy to make rewindable, make rewindable.

record.title: Dynamite Tile Bug - Child tiles are exploded although the parent is not.
record.description:
Dynamite tile explode the child tiles but the parent child stays depending on the radius. The remaining child tiles are closed even though there are no apparent p/c relationship with the parent tile. 

Check the video for better reference:

[[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_1069].8479161.mp4]([URL_50551])

I created a level where that behavior can be observed. It's in `qa/bomb-parent-child` branch, chapter 1 level 16. 

Expected outcomes can be one of the followings: 

* Don't explode the tiles when the parent tile is not exploded,
* Don't explode the tiles when the child tile is not exploded,
* Explode the parent or grand parent tiles that wouldn't be exploded by the bomb itself,
* Explode everything in radius then rearrange p/c relationship
* Or just designing levels by playtesting so that those kind of visual problems won't happen.

The UPDATED EXPECTED BEHAVIOR is

* Checking the tiles within the bomb radius
  * If there is any other bomb tile, trigger to explode it
  * If tiles has no parent (or all parents are discarded), directly explode
* Checking the parents and children of tiles within the bomb radius
  * If all CURRENT children and parents are within the radius
* Mark the tiles whose ALL CURRENT children and parent tiles are affected by the explosion as VALID
* Then explode every valid tiles.

record.title: Game shouldn't be playable without internet connection.
record.description:
UPDATED ISSUE

* The game is not opened offline but there is no connection error message. 
* If the connection is lost after the splash screen, the game is playable. The progression is naturally not saved. 
  * If another session is started online, the progression is lost. 

    [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_1084]_0ed2d384a7e28d6134e98d8e5c97b585.mp4]([URL_50597])

---

---

There are couple of issues about connection loss and we need to have the data saved in the backend. So the proposed suggestion is to make the game requires internet connection anytime. The steps to implement it may vary in term of performances.

An interval can be implemented to check if there is internet connection at that time. If not it can try to access to the internet connection for 2 seconds just in case there is small connection loss for a sec. If there is still no internet connection shows the pop-up to reconnect again. 

For the quest, chest and event reward claims, if claiming them offline gives players another chance to claim, it should be corrected by the backend when the data is accessible.

record.title: Memory Game Sound Overlap Issue Breaking the Core Game
record.description:
version: ios 1456 & android 1474

When the memory game is started directly without playing any levels in the core game, its music starts to play. But after a match, match SFX starts to play and stops the game music. When the game music stops, there are many different issue happens:

**Issues on Memory Game**

* The second attempt on memory game by going back to minigame hub then replay has no music just the matching sound.
  * Via replay button, the music continues but the match SFX is not playing.
* The streak bar in the memory game doesn't fill up. (but it's functionally there)

**Issues In the core game**

* The match SFXs are not played.
* Streak announcement SFXs are not played but the texts pop up.
* Tiles matched to complete a streak is not going to the hand pile but the tiles beneath are flipped up.
* Streak rewards are not granted as well as the sprite doesn't change.
* When character tokens are matched, the tile stays there but the tiles beneath are flipped up along with the character token is obtained.
* Vanishing tiles don't vanish nor their colors changes so vanishing tiles are just tiles from then on.
* Bomb tiles doesn't explode just matched as a regular tile and it's not going to the hand pile but the tiles beneath are flipped up.
* If the tile in the hand pile isn't changed after a match, the symbol on it continue to the target symbol to match other tiles.

So to sum up, when the memory game is played immediately without playing the core game, the memory match music or SFX is gone after that every action that is tied to a SFX is not executed correctly. Remember it doesn't happen when the core game is played first.

record.title: The Lucky Drop slot reel animations are taking so long.
record.description:
[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5853]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_51462])

If the tokens are spent quickly, the slot animations are taking so long because they are probably being queued where the animations continue even though there is no token to drop. 

SO the repro steps are:

1. Just drop as many tokens with fast clicks
2. Observe that those slot animations are still playing with no token dropping. 

Description: The current animation for leftover tokens takes too long, with a delay of 10-15 seconds between the last token drop and the end of the animation. The animation needs to be cut short to be more in sync with the final token drop, ideally completing a couple of seconds after the last token goes through.

Solution Requirements:

Investigate if stacked effects are contributing to the delay. Adjust the animation timing to ensure it finishes shortly after the last token is dropped, no more than a couple of seconds later. Ensure smooth transitions to prevent unnecessary delays that disrupt gameplay flow.

record.title: Implement a fall back strategy if the tutorial couldn't find relevant highlighted object
record.description:
We would try to cover those scenarios as much as we can. However, it would be great to have a fall back strategy for scenarios we couldn't test it out. So if any tutorial has a step to highlight an object or UI component that the component is missing, then implement the fall back as marking tutorial completed or putting "tap anywhere to continue" function with some delays. 

With those method, we can cover all the tutorials broken based on the highlight problems. At least they won't create hard blocker for the player progression.

record.title: The rewind animation continues so long if it's used too frequent
record.description:
Version or date: ios 269

### Description: 

Drawing tile and rewinding it back and forth so much queues the animation for them. But if player want to continue playing animation blocks the gameplay because the actions taken later are also queued in all animations.  

Therefore, player cannot see the tiles drawn, tiles matched etc. because the animations of rewind can still continue. 

### Visual References:

[RPReplay_Final1730486571.MP4]([URL_51557])

### Expected Outcome: is to cancel animations of rewind when the actual game action is taken by drawing or matching any tiles.

1. Start a level
2. Draw a tile 
3. Rewind it quickly
4. Do the 2nd and 3rd step too much
5. Observe that the animations continue
6. Draw a tile 
7. Observe that the tile is not visible because the hand area is occupied.

record.title: Quest Refresh Notification is pushed in wrong time and wrong amount
record.description:
Version or date: ios 296

### Description: 

The push notification for refreshed daily quests is sent in the wrong time. It looks like it's based on the local time but when I started a session the quests are not refreshed at all.

As it can be also seen, I got 2 same notifications.  

### Visual References:

[RPReplay_Final1730840450.MP4]([URL_51588])

### Expected Outcome: is to push notifications when the quests are really refreshed. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Unlock quests
2. Wait for midnight
3. Click on the notification
4. Observe that no changes in quests.

record.title: The prelevel dialogue arrow bleeds through profile & inventory
record.description:
Version or date: android 343

### Description:

record.title: Foresight transparency make the parent tiles transparent
record.description:

1. Reveal a tile that has couple parents and at least one grandparent
2. Match the revealed tile 
3. Observe that the grandparent is still transparent while the parents are not
4. Rewind the match
5. Observe the unsynchronous transparency

record.title: Load the latest chapter scene when the game is started
record.description:
Version or date: ios 664

### Description: 

When the loading is interrupted for the transition to chapter 2, the next session starts in chapter 1 and there is no tutorial to teach them to change the chapter. For those kind of scenarios and for better usability, we should load the latest chapter.

* The latest chapter will be based on the furthest level completed +1 level.
  * If player completes a chapter and kill the app, they should see the next chapter when they start the app again.
  * If player goes back in the completed chapter to play levels, the latest chapter should load when the app is started. 
  * In other every scenario, start the game with the current chapter where the latest level is completed.

**java.lang.Exception - NullReferenceException : Object reference not set to an instance of an object.**

It happens when he returned back to play the levels that he already completed earlier.

record.title: The shadows of the tile are not visible
record.description:
Version or date: ios 689 & android 836

### Description: 

The tiles are touching each other which hinders the shadow effect on the tiles. The tiles should have some spaces between them to show the shadows on them. 

### Visual References:

[[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5962].7150011.mp4]([URL_51852])

### Expected Outcome: to make the tiles not touching each other that much.

record.title: Tooltip Cleaning for the final FTUE
record.description:
Tooltip cleaning

* Shop has no tooltip when locked
* Character button "Unlocks at level 11" should change into chapter 2 level 15.
* Minigame button "Unlocks at Level 13" should change into chapter 2 level 12.
* Leaderboard button should change into chapter 2 level 4 instead of Coming soon...
* For quests pop up, it should change into "Reach Chapter 2 Level 2 to unlock quests" rather than "Reach Chapter 2 level 16 to unlock quests"
* Remove all the individual minigame tooltips since they are unlocked together.
* For the characters, Nate will be unlocked before the minigame button so no need for a tool tip for him.
  * For julius, it should say Unlocks at Chapter 3 Level 1.
  * For Lexi, it should say Unlocks at Chapter 3 Level 9

Version or date: ios 812

### Description: 

Achievements don’t have "Buy Item from the Shop" & "Match Tiles" achievements. 

### Visual References:

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5964]_1.MP4]([URL_51869])

record.title: Bomb tile used for nothing if the face up tiles are not convertible
record.description:
Version or date: ios 840

### Description: 

Since the bomb boost is converting the face up tiles into bomb tiles, bomb tiles are used for nothing if there are no tiles eligible to convert bomb tiles. Even though it has no tile to convert, it still consume coins and amount in the inventory. 

### Visual References: 

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5965]_1.MP4]([URL_51870])

### Expected Outcome: is to gray out the bomb boost or continue to convert non-faced up tiles. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Start a late bomb level
2. Match every regular tiles until there are only bomb tiles left
3. Use bomb boosts
4. Observe that it has no effect even though coins are consumed.

record.title: Julius' tooltip in FTUE quests causes FPS drop after clicking.
record.description:
Version or date: ios 840 

### Description: 

The tooltip in Julius's icon is giving null references. It shows 

* wrong amount of token required
* wrong reward sprite
* and causes massive FPS drop  

### Visual References:

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5967]_1.MP4]([URL_51872])

![Screenshot_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5966]-65_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.jpg]([URL_51871])

### Expected Outcome: is to not give a null reference, to show the actual token amount required, and the correct sprite.

### Steps to Repro:

1. Click on Julius in FTUE quests.

record.title: FTUE quests are not counted once they are visible
record.description:
Version or date: android 111 submission

### Description: 

The FTUE quests are available in the saga map after 1-10 but the quests are not counted as completed even though they're completed. Players need to redo the same quests to count them as completed. 

### Visual References:

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5968]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_51873])

### Expected Outcome: is to count the quests as completed as soon as the FTUE quest icon is visible in the saga map. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Unlock FTUE quests
2. Change your avatar or name
3. Observe that they don't count as completed.

record.title: 3rd chest in FTUE quests has the wrong reward icon in reward screen
record.description:
Version or date: ios 840

### Description: 

The 3rd chest shows and gives bomb tile boosts but the reward screen shows gold tile with different scale.

### Visual References:

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5970]_1.MP4]([URL_51875])

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5969]_1.MP4]([URL_51874])

### Expected Outcome: is to sync the chest reward icons and replace gold tile icon with bomb tile. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Check the tooltip of 3rd chest in FTUE quests
2. Earn it
3. Observe that it shows wrong in reward screen.

record.title: Gacha rewards are persistent if I navigate through navigation bar.
record.description:
Version or date: ios 820

### Description: 

Gacha rewards are persistent if I navigate through navigation bar. They are triggered every time the screen is opened. And the reward animation continue to be triggered if I use navigation bar to change screens.  

### Visual References:

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5971]_1.MP4]([URL_51876])

### Expected Outcome: is to close the reward screen after giving them and make it above the navigation screen like all other reward screens. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Buy a pack
2. Wait for reward
3. Change screen via navigation bar.

record.title: The FTUE quests button is present after completing all the quests
record.description:
Version or date: ios 840

### Description: 

Even though the quest event is completely finished and everything is claimed. It should disappear after claiming the julius tokens as the last milestone. 

### Visual References:

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5972]_1.MP4]([URL_51877])

### Expected Outcome: to disappear the button after claiming the julius tokens as the last milestone.

### Steps to Repro:

1. Complete all the 4-day quests
2. Observe the event button stays there even though nothing left to do.

But there are more achievements to populate after them.

record.title: Icon Management System
record.description:
'@julia.lawson to fill up 

The Icon Management System in very simple terms in a "queue manager for the live ops icon". The documentation for the system can be found here: 

[[URL_51975])

As a quick rundown, the system determines the following: 

* The number of icons on a scene
* When they will appear whether locked or unlocked
* What side of the screen will an icon appear 
* In what order an icon will appear 
* When will the icon disappear and/or change places 
* The various elements on the icon like time, buttons, notifications, etc. 
* Seasonal changes

record.title: Quest Inıt Issue Persist on some users

I've finally managed to repro the `quest.init` issue that actual players are facing. I wasn't recording once the issue starts but here is what I did.

* After getting the quests unlocked, I started to claim every achievements.
* At some point due to my fast clicking, the next achievement isn't populated. The achievement was `Match certain tiles`

record.title: Queue Manager Improvements
record.description:
In order to prevent overlaps of pop-ups, we should be able to come up with a solution. 

So there is no way to prevent scenarios where players are voluntarily clicking on some buttons which makes the pop up issues even bigger. 

* ~~First of all, win&collect reward animation should be updated instead of showing full screen reward for just a one reward. It should be updated like fading out.  Reuse that animation when the progress bar for the win&collect is full. Instead of triggering a reward screen show the going up and fading out animation.~~ 

  [claimRewardSmall001 (1).mp4]([URL_52220])
* Secondly, put input blocker for the saga map until the queue manager is over and the avatar movement is started. 
  * But to be precise, regular input blocker is not enough for that because the pop ups should be closed via some clicks like close or continue buttons. To prevent those kind of issues, we need to introduce input blocker only for the saga map 3d scene buttons (as level nodes) and saga map generic UIs. Any other pop up over that screen should be interactable. 
* Thirdly, change the order that token animations are staying together. Currently, axe arena, season pass, and streak fever tokens goes first, then nate's treasure hunt, and then win& collect and level rewards. Instead, make all reward and token animations together, put the nate's win streak later. 
* Make pop ups wait for the reward animations
* The general idea should be implemented in a way that the queue continues with a pop-up triggered and until closing it the queue should wait, if it's closed then continue. 

So what we need to accomplish that is :

1. Organized UI hierarchy in pop ups and saga map buttons via layers. 
2. Implement input blocker until the queue is over and avatar movement is started. 
3. To have more profound experience, we also need to fasten up the saga map token animations and queue the event token animations as well. Because currently, the screen is too crowded with all the reward animations.

record.title: River Rush infinite lives are not committed to playerprofile
record.description:
Version or date: ios 1421

### Description: 

The event is giving an 15-min infinite lives for Stage 1 start. But the reward is reverted back after completing a level. 

Besides that, the infinite lives should be only given for the first time in hat day. So if player fails to complete stage 1, they shouldn't be awarded with infinite lives again when they restart stage 1. 

### Visual References:

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6134]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_52279])

### Expected Outcome: is to commit the changes into player profile and not giving 15 min infinite lives in stage 1 replay.  

### Steps to Repro:

1. Unlcok river rush
2. Start the event
3. Observe that it gives 15 min infinite lives
4. Win a level
5. Observe that it reverted back.

record.title: Streak Fever Token is visible on level win screen when event is not started
record.description:

### Description: 

When the streak fever is available but player doesn't' start the event, the streak fever tokens are already visible on the win screen of levels. It doesn't affect the event flow but it would be misleading to show them as they are obtained by the player. 

### Visual References:

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6135]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_52280])

1. Unlock streak fever
2. See the streak fever intro pop up and close it without participating
3. Win a level with at least 1 streak
4. Observe that the tokens are visible in the win screen
5. And the event is not started.

record.title: Randomize number of winning players in Nate's Treasure Hunt
record.description:
Currently, the rewards are always split for 5 players which makes the experience fake for players. 

What we need to do is to randomize the number of players who are winning the event so that the reward will be split in different amounts. 

What we need for that is to have a dynamic text of `left players`,  `coin amount` as reward based on left players, and the visualization of "other players" who won the event. The best and easiest solution for that would be :

* As it can be seen, we're always giving the reward for 5 players including us. But when the amount will change, we don't have a back up situation for visualizing the other winners. 

  ![image.png]([URL_52343])
  * For that I think the best approach is to randomize the amount of winners from 5 to 10. 
  * In that way we can keep the first 3 winners the same all the time. And if it's 5, it should look the same as the current version. 
    * If it's more than 5, we can use something like that by putting an integer with a circler around to show how many additional players won the event. 

      ![image.png]([URL_52342])

@[PERSON_NAME_0029] is still working on the bigger ticket which is also fix the issue as well. But for now, finding a quick solution would be great. 

Like Season Pass which is also loading from addressable, we can freeze the game until the scene is loaded but it's not an optimal solution either. 

What we can do for now might be not loading the scene while the board scene is loaded at least. Bleeding over with the other screens are not frequent and problematic as in the board scene. 

In fact another idea is to put the scene right after the win screen. Instead of going to the saga map, players can be auto directed to the Nate's win streak scene after tapping on the win screen of level.   

Tbh, I don't know what is the quickest and the most bug-free solution for now.

![image.png]([URL_52348])

record.title: Sophie's win animation happens too frequent
record.description:
Version or date: global builds

### Description: 

After every level win, players are forced to watch Sophie's win animation with the crown falling. It makes the experience boring and repetitive too quickly. 

### Visual References: 

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6237]_1.MP4]([URL_52503])

record.title: Addressable Issues
record.description:
Version or date:

### Description: 

We have 2 different big issues about the addressable management.

1. Every update in the game re-downloads all the unlocked scenes again. (even if it's only prefab update.)
2. Offload the completed chapters so that the game uses less storage. 

Expected outcome: 

1. instantiate worldmap uı isolated from the chapter scenes. 
2. keep the chapter completed, current chapter, and the next chapter.

record.title: Downloading fonts takes too much time and it makes the game looks like frozen.
record.description:

### Description: 

Font downloading might take some time (for me in the video almost took 1 min) and we have no information to show the game is downloading something. It looks like it stuck at 22% for a while.
What we can do is to add information to the splash screen if the language assets are downloading, or create a fake progress from 22% up until 42%.

record.title: Minigame tokens are not generated by the timer
record.description:
Version or date: iOS_Submission_151, Dev_iOS_1606, Dev_Android_1879, Android_Submission_211

### Description: 

After the universal timer fixes, the minigame token timer is not working. It will not increase by the time-based token generation but it can successfully increase by the leftover tokens. 

It always stuck at 3m

### Visual References: 

![image.png]([URL_52530])

### Expected Outcome: is to start the timer after it drops below 50 and generate tokens based on the fixed rate of 1 for each 3 min. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Start Tile Dozer or Lucky Drop
2. Drop tokens until it's below 50 
3. Observe that 3 minute is static.

record.title: Missing Translation on shop offers after visiting language section
record.description:
Version or date: iOS_Submission_151, Dev_iOS_1606, Dev_Android_1879, Android_Submission_211

### Description: 

When the language selection screen is opened but closed without changing the language, most of the texts in the shop has missing translation but it resolves after scene refresh (by playing level or loading the chapter again) 

### Visual References: 

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6244]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_52531])

### Expected Outcome: If a new language isn't selected, don't change anything related to that. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Visit language screen
2. Wait for 2 seconds
3. Don't select anything
4. Quit the screen
5. Go to shop and observe that there are missing translations.

record.title: Pop-up offers are persistent when I toggle disabling them for 24 hours
record.description:
Version or date: iOS_Submission_151, Dev_iOS_1606, Dev_Android_1879, Android_Submission_21

### Description: 

There is an option to toggle the pop-up offers to disable them for 24 hours but apparently it doesn't work anymore. When I toggled to disable them, the next session they are directly popping up. In addition, the toggle preferences are not saved across the sessions. 

### Visual References:

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6245]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_52532])

### Expected Outcome: is to disable the automatic pop-ups if their individual toggle for disabling them is on for the next 24 hours. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Unlock pop up offers
2. Toggle on the disabling option
3. Kill the app and restart
4. Observe that changes are not saved and they are still popping up.

record.title: Character Tutorial Triggered every level from 4 to 10.
record.description:
* **App Version:** 0.1.824
* **Device:** iPhone 11
* **Bug / Issue:**
  * The character screen tutorial is triggered unexpectedly after completing level 4.
  * The tutorial persists from levels 4 to 10 after every level end.
  * It's a blocker issue as it prevents tapping on the character panel.
  * Tapping on the home button triggers the tutorial again.
  * The tutorial appears completely misplaced, with all buttons unlocked from the debug menu.
  * Trying to complete the tutorial prompts to upgrade Sophie without any token earned.
  * It's blocking every other tutorial between the 4th to 10th level.
* **Expected Outcome:**
  * The character tutorial should be triggered after earning a Sophie token, which should happen after level 10.
* **Step Descriptions to Reproduce:**
  * Play the game until the 10th level.
* **Bug Visuals:**
  * Bug visuals can be viewed at the following links:

record.title: Minigame tutorial last step to go home is broken.
record.description:
**Description:**
The minigame tutorial on iPhone 11 is experiencing a malfunction during the final step to go home. Specifically, the home button keeps dimming, preventing completion of the tutorial. According to the expected behavior, the tutorial should be completed after returning to the home screen.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1. Launch the minigame tutorial.
2. Progress through the tutorial until the last step.
3. Attempt to return to the home screen.

**Expected Result:**
The tutorial should be marked as completed after returning to the home screen.

**Actual Result:**
The home button keeps dimming, preventing completion of the tutorial.

**Additional Information:**

record.title: Tutorial Bug - Quitting the game without completing the chapter end tutorial breaks the flow
record.description:
**Version: 0.1265**

Quitting the game without completing **the chapter end tutorial** breaks the game for later.

In the second launch, saga map isn't scrollable along with other stuffs.

We should consider disabling the tutorial if the game is killed during that specific tutorial.

[RPReplay_Final1713950775.MP4]([URL_50227])

As you can see here in the updated video, the tutorial is broken by quitting the game during the tutorial. When I restart the app again, the tutorial looks like stuck at "hide chapter complete".  The issue is persistent with all app restarts. However, completing 16 levels are not helpful to disable the tutorial. So the requirement panel on the left lower corner might not be functional in terms of "equal" function. 

Another issue might be "0" second in the "hide chapter complete" step because that step was already skipped in the first tutorial. However, tutorials might start from the latest completed step in default.

## The outcomes of the issue are:

* Core game broken for the first level in the chapter 2 
  * draw tiles are not visible, three tiles stays in the middle just visually. 
* Bomb tutorial cannot be triggered due to an ongoing tutorial.  
* Saga map is not scrollable
* Restarting the app trigger the time boost tutorial which is already buggy and blocker.
* Then every new tutorial cannot be triggered due to its persistency as the on-going tutorial. 
  * memory game tutorial 
  * vanishing tutorial 
  * quest tutorial etc.

# What can be done to eliminate it?

* Making sure that equal function in the tutorial requirement panel is functional
* Marking the tutorials in the saga map as complete when they are interrupted by killing the app

record.title: Icon and Event Visual for Win Streak Event (axe arena)
record.description:
An event about win streak multiplier. 

As you continue to win levels, the score multiplier increases and after every level win players will win more scores. When they lose, the multiplier resets to x1. The event will last 2 days and top players will be rewarded based on the score collected. 

So I'm thinking something contains "deadeye" to emphasize the winning streak with accuracy plus the zombie theme. Here is the potential names: 

1. Deadeye Carnage
2. Deadeye Tournament
3. Deadeye Rampage
4. Deadeye Run
5. Chain the Dead
6. One Shot, One Kill

![image.png]([URL_52696])

![]([URL_52695])

 **Here is the potential prompt**

* **Event Icon Prompt (Badge/Icon Format)**

A bold 2D cartoon-style digital illustration designed for a mobile game event icon. The image features a colorful target with concentric blue, red, and cream rings, with a glossy zombie eyeball at the center. The target is positioned on the left, while three angry green zombie heads with glowing yellow eyes are stacked to the right, each drawn with sharp outlines and exaggerated expressions. The color palette is vibrant, and the shadows are clean and game-ready. The art has a playful but slightly menacing tone, fitting a zombie-themed casual RPG. There is no text, and the icon is centered with transparent or dark neutral background for layering on various UI.

* **Main Event Page Visual Prompt (Hero Image Format)**

A wide-format 2D digital illustration in a polished cartoon style, meant for a mobile game event screen. On the left side is a large red-blue-cream target with a detailed zombie eyeball in the center. To the right, three fierce green zombie heads are stacked with glowing yellow eyes and sharp facial shadows. The background is a dark brown gradient with light texture to add depth without distraction. The layout is balanced for mobile UI design, leaving space for overlayed buttons or text. The tone is energetic and competitive, capturing the spirit of a limited-time win streak event where precision and momentum matter. No text is included in the image.

record.title: Reorganize Event Icon Grouping and Replacement
record.description:
**Description:**
Currently, we have many event icons displayed on the main screen. To improve clarity and user navigation, we can adopt a grouping approach similar to *Royal Match*.

**Proposed Change:**

* Group **only-reward events** (e.g., Zombie Lane, Season Pass, Quests) on one side (e.g., right).
* Keep **playable events** on the opposite side (e.g., left).
* Alternatively, we can switch sides — placement order is flexible as long as the grouping remains consistent.

**Goal:**
Improve UI organization and help players quickly identify different event types.

![image.png]([URL_52778])

**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Event icons are consistently grouped by type.
* UI remains balanced and visually clear.
* No loss of functionality or discoverability for any event.
* The order of them is consistent when another event icon is not visible. 

**Adjustable Parameters:**

Since we need to test how it looks in the game. We need certain adjustable parameters for next iterations. 

* The group of an event
* The interchangeable placement for different groups (we can make right icons in the left for later)
* The order of an event within its group

record.title: Tutorial Bug - Quitting the game without completing the chapter end tutorial breaks the flow
record.description:
**Version: 0.1265**

Quitting the game without completing **the chapter end tutorial** breaks the game for later.

In the second launch, saga map isn't scrollable along with other stuffs.

We should consider disabling the tutorial if the game is killed during that specific tutorial.

[RPReplay_Final1713950775.MP4]([URL_50227])

As you can see here in the updated video, the tutorial is broken by quitting the game during the tutorial. When I restart the app again, the tutorial looks like stuck at "hide chapter complete".  The issue is persistent with all app restarts. However, completing 16 levels are not helpful to disable the tutorial. So the requirement panel on the left lower corner might not be functional in terms of "equal" function. 

Another issue might be "0" second in the "hide chapter complete" step because that step was already skipped in the first tutorial. However, tutorials might start from the latest completed step in default.

## The outcomes of the issue are:

* Core game broken for the first level in the chapter 2 
  * draw tiles are not visible, three tiles stays in the middle just visually. 
* Bomb tutorial cannot be triggered due to an ongoing tutorial.  
* Saga map is not scrollable
* Restarting the app trigger the time boost tutorial which is already buggy and blocker.
* Then every new tutorial cannot be triggered due to its persistency as the on-going tutorial. 
  * memory game tutorial 
  * vanishing tutorial 
  * quest tutorial etc.

# What can be done to eliminate it?

* Making sure that equal function in the tutorial requirement panel is functional
* Marking the tutorials in the saga map as complete when they are interrupted by killing the app
* Restarting the tutorial from the beginning
* Checking the first trigger and requirements of the tutorials when the app is restarted. If the prerequisites are not met, then don't trigger it. 
* Implementing AND function on step trigger events like if the player is in Chapter 1 scene and complete 15 levels then the tutorial should be triggered. 

First @[PERSON_NAME_0050] try to solve the issues about that. 

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_1058]_0ed2d384a7e28d6134e98d8e5c97b585.mp4]([URL_50226])

>
> ![image.png]([URL_50371])
>

The reason for that issue is because of the tutorial method. It's being triggered by chapter 3 load so the tutorial directly starts and doesn't let players to scroll. I think what we need is the "and" function for tutorial triggem rs to trigger it when chapter 3 is loaded AND Puzzle_1 object is clicked.

record.title: Zombie Ops #3 Spec (Dead Eye)
record.description:
This is the first try/win-streak-based LiveOps event, aka the zombie version of Axe Arena. The working title is Brains Aims. Some other fun names could be: Brains Aims, Aims For Brains, Skull Shot, Rot Shot, Cannon Fodder, Boom Bloom.

The visuals are minimal for this spec, essentially only an icon theme selection. The spec and infrastructure are easily copied.

![image.png]([URL_52385])

![image.png]([URL_52384])

Some brainstorm starter themes and iteration ideas:

1. Shooting board with a zombie head nailed on it by an axe (complete reuse of assets if we're on a crunch), or an arrow. 
2. An icon based on a theme: brain, cannonball, tombstone. Anything to replace the helmet of Helmet Rush.   
3. Multipliers come with evolving icons. For example, a humble cross tombstone for x1 and a full crypt for x10. Or military officer ranks based on our main hero. 
4. Are we going to tie it to a currency like in Match Factory? We can give out a currency like cannon ammunition to be a win-streak booster style shield for the cannon. Or health packs that temporarily increase the cannon's HP.
